Quick Answer

narrative.overview: The site reads like a well-made travel guidebook about one building: warm stone paper, confident serif headings, and colour used the way the basilica uses stained glass, in deliberate moments rather than everywhere. A visitor should feel they are being advised by an independent, calm expert, not sold to.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone paper background with ink-dark text, never pure black on pure white
Serif display headings, sans-serif for facts, prices and controls
Terracotta is the action colour; teal is the link/information colour; gold marks ratings and the recommended choice
Rounded, tactile cards that lift slightly on hover
Every third-party fact is attributed and dated next to where it appears

rules.name: The Stained-Glass Rule
rules.body: Colour arrives in moments. Terracotta appears only on things you can press; teal only on things that inform or link; gold only on ratings and the recommended pick.

rules.name: The Attributed Fact Rule
rules.body: Any rating, review count, duration, price or opening hour copied from a third party shows its source and/or checked date next to it.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks about the place; sans states the facts.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Shadows grow only when a visitor points at something they can act on.

dos: Do keep booking buttons terracotta pills with specific labels, and put the affiliate note directly under booking groups.
Do show rating source and checked dates next to every third-party fact.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for headings and the system sans for facts, prices and controls.
Do use real photographs of the basilica, with descriptive alt text, served through the image optimizer.
Do keep sections on Stone Paper / Stone Mist with 64px vertical rhythm.
donts: Don't add countdown timers, "only X left", "best price" stamps, flashing or animated urgency badges, or struck-through prices you can't verify.
Don't use purple-gradient heroes beyond the existing plum photo overlay, glassmorphism beyond the hero rating card, or generic three-icon feature grids.
Don't put ratings or reviews into structured data; they belong to the booking provider.
Don't introduce a new accent colour; extend with tints of terracotta, teal, gold or plum.
